A map of the Nigeria area in the mid-19th century showing the Kingdom of Benin in the center. Arrows pointing outwards indicate Benin's relations with its neighbours: West towards Akure and Ekiti (Yorubaland), North towards Afenmai and Nupe, Northeast towards Esan (Ishan), East across the Niger River to Asaba/Agbor (Western Igbo), and South towards the Niger Delta (Itsekiri, Urhobo).
